reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The preferred position is 'No non-solicit on Customer'; the absence of any non-solicit, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant therefore satisfies the preferred position, and 'missing' would be the wrong classification because the rule does not expect a restriction to exist.

The cited text supports the conclusion: p0035 (General Manager liaison) and p0061 (No Joint Venture) contain only incidental references to employees/representatives and impose no restriction on soliciting or hiring either Party's personnel.
The two failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are vacuous here — there is no covenant to measure — so they do not undercut the finding.
Correctly avoids double-flagging the Section 6 exclusivity covenants, which restrict competing projects rather than personnel and belong to a separate rule.
